messages.content: The research question is whether retrieval augmentation beats fine-tuning on our support corpus.
Read the RAG survey and reviewed four papers on domain adaptation. Still investigating whether index size matters.
what did the first run show
The experiment showed RAG at 71 percent and fine-tuning at 68 percent on the held-out set. This contradicts the vendor benchmark, which put fine-tuning ahead.
Not statistically significant at n=120. The sample is too small to call it. Measured a 4 point spread across three seeds.
Concluded that retrieval wins on our corpus for cost reasons even at parity. Open question whether it holds for documents over 8k tokens.
Still analysing the per-category breakdown. Found that the gap is entirely in the billing questions.
